arxiv-2304-06071.title: Stellar Signals of a Baryon-Number-Violating Long-Range Force
arxiv-2304-06071.creator: Hooman Davoudiasl
arxiv-2304-06071.description: Abstract We entertain the novel possibility that long range forces may lead to violations of accidental symmetries, in particular baryon number. Employing an ultralight scalar, with a mass ≪ \ll eV, we illustrate that this scenario can lead to vastly disparate nucleon lifetimes, in different astronomical objects.

arxiv-2401-10492.title: Betti numbers for connected sums of graded Gorenstein Artinian algebras Thanks: Altafi was supported by Swedish Research Council grant VR2021-00472, Galetto was supported by NSF DMS–2200844, Miró-Roig was partially supported by the grant PID2020-113674GB-I00, Nagel was partially supported by Simons
arxiv-2401-10492.creator: Nasrin Altafi, Roberta Di Gennaro, Federico Galetto, Sean Grate, Rosa M. Miró-Roig, Uwe Nagel, Alexandra Seceleanu, Junzo Watanabe
arxiv-2401-10492.description: Abstract . The connected sum construction, which takes as input Gorenstein rings and produces new Gorenstein rings, can be considered as an algebraic analogue for the topological construction having the same name. We determine the graded Betti numbers for connected sums of graded Artinian Gorenstein algebras.

arxiv-2406-03998.title: Déterminant d’une matrice carrée
arxiv-2406-03998.creator: Elisabeth Remm
arxiv-2406-03998.description: Abstract \markleft Poisson Si a désigne une matrice carrée à coefficients réels ou complexes, le calcul de son déterminant est initié dès les premières années du lycée, en commençant par les matrices d’ordre 2 et le produit en croix, puis pour les matrices d’ordre 3 .

arxiv-2407-06628.title: Masked Video and Body-worn IMU Autoencoder for Egocentric Action Recognition
arxiv-2407-06628.creator: Mingfang Zhang, Yifei Huang ∗, Ruicong Liu, Yoichi Sato
arxiv-2407-06628.description: Abstract Compared with visual signals, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) placed on human limbs can capture accurate motion signals while being robust to lighting variation and occlusion. While these characteristics are intuitively valuable to help egocentric action recognition, the potential of IMUs remains under-explored.

arxiv-2501-05891.title: Affordably Fine-tuned LLMs Provide Better Answers to Course-specific MCQs Conference: The 40th ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing; March 31-April 4, 2025; Catania, Italy The 40th ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC ’25), March 31-April 4, 2025, Catania, Italy DOI: 10.1145/3672608.3
arxiv-2501-05891.creator: Bianca Raimondi, Saverio Giallorenzo, Maurizio Gabbrielli
arxiv-2501-05891.description: Abstract . In education, the capability of generating human-like text of Large Language Models (LLMs) inspired work on how they can increase the efficiency of learning and teaching. We study the affordability of these models for educators and students by investigating how LLMs answer multiple-choice questions (MCQs) with respect to hardware constraints and refinement techniques.

arxiv-2601-19141.title: Origin of the nucleon gravitational form factor B N ​ ( t ) B_{N}(t)
arxiv-2601-19141.creator: Xianghui Cao, Bheemsehan Gurjar, Chandan Mondal, Chen Chen, Yang Li
arxiv-2601-19141.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xianghui Cao, Bheemsehan Gurjar, Chandan Mondal, Chen Chen, Yang Li. Recent lattice QCD simulations and phenomenological models indicate that the nucleon’s gravitational form factor B N ​ ( t ) B_{N}(t) remains remarkably small at finite momentum transfer t t . While B N ​ ( 0 ) = 0 B_{N}(0)=0 is a known consequence of the equivalence principle, the physical origin of its suppression at finite t t has not been fully elucidated.

Chemically, it is thus indentical identical with the cubic mineral diamond, but between the two there are very wide differences in physical characters. Graphite is black and opaque, whilst diamond is colourless and transparent; it is one of the softest (H＝1) of minerals, and diamond the hardest of all; it is a good conductor of electricity, whilst diamond is a bad conductor.

pmc-10802119.title: A combined analysis of TyG index, SII index, and SIRI index: positive association with CHD risk and coronary atherosclerosis severity in patients with NAFLD
pmc-10802119.creator: Wenyuan Dong, Yuxin Gong, Jianqi Zhao, Yanan Wang, Bao Li, Youdong Yang
pmc-10802119.description: BackgroundInsulin resistance(IR) and inflammation have been regarded as common potential mechanisms in coronary heart disease (CHD) and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). Triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index is a novel biomarker of insulin resistance, System immune-inflammation index(SII) and Systemic inflammation response index(SIRI) are novel biomarkers of inflammation, these biomarkers have not been studied in CHD with NAFLD patients.

pmc-11354220.title: Community-Based Mental Health Challenges and Implications: Examining Factors Influencing Distress and Help-Seeking Behaviors among Korean American Church Leaders and Members in Greater Los Angeles
pmc-11354220.creator: Kelly Baek, Christi Bell, Susanne B Montgomery, Larry Ortiz, Akinchita Kumar, Qais Alemi, Hyojin Im, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-11354220.description: There is limited research on the factors that impact mental distress among Korean American (KA) church leaders even though their unique social situation can create many barriers to seeking mental health assistance. This study compared factors impacting mental distress and help-seeking behaviors between KA church leaders (CLs) and church members (CMs) in the greater Los Angeles area.

pmc-11606178.title: Experiences with COVID-19 economic relief measures among low-wage worker families: a qualitative study
pmc-11606178.creator: Caitlin E Caspi, Maria Gombi-Vaca, Curtis Antrum, Salma Gudaf, Molly De Marco, Emily Welle, Brett Sheppard, Kristi Fordyce, Rebekah Pratt
pmc-11606178.description: BackgroundEconomic stability is a core social determinant of health and a necessary condition for maintaining food security, housing stability, and both physical and mental health. Using a qualitative approach, we identified barriers, facilitators, and participant perceptions about utilizing these relief measures.

pmc-11935555.title: Increased Plasma β‐Secretase 1 Activity Correlates With Neurodegeneration in Cerebral Small Vessel Disease
pmc-11935555.creator: Ya Su, Qiong Wang, Feng Gao, Jiajie Xu, Jiayu Fu, Yunqing Ying, Yiwei Xia, Xiaoxiao Wang, Qiang Dong, Yong Shen, Xin Cheng
pmc-11935555.description: Background β‐secretase 1 (BACE1) plays a key role in amyloidogenic pathway and is considered a new mechanism for cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD). We explore the potential role of plasma BACE1 in CSVD and the pathological process it may be involved in.

pmc-12579071.title: Advancement in nanocarrier-mediated delivery of herbal bioactives: from bench to beside
pmc-12579071.creator: Fatemeh Najafi, Negar Farrokhzad, Amirhossein Ghaemi, Dorsa Azizi Khezri, Mohammadali Hajiabbas, Amirhossein Khanizadeh, Nasim Kaveh Farsani, Mahsa Khoramipour, Niloofar Fatemipayam, Elham Seyyedi Zadeh, Arash Goodarzi, Behnoosh Khodadadi, Fatemeh Moradbeygi, Ahmad Reza Farmani, Mohammad Tavakkoli Y
pmc-12579071.description: The resurgence of interest in traditional herbal remedies stems from an increasing appreciation for their complex phytochemical profiles and potential for synergistic therapeutic effects. However, the therapeutic potential of plant extracts is often limited by poor absorption and potential toxicity related to conventional delivery methods.

pmc-12607783.title: TRPV1 Blocker, Peptide HCRG21 from Sea Anemone Heteractis magnifica, Exhibits Effectiveness in Psoriasis and Dermatitis in In Vivo Models
pmc-12607783.creator: Anna Klimovich, Aleksandra Kvetkina, Yulia Deryavko, Nadezhda Priymenko, Daria Popkova, Evgenia Bystritskaya, Marina Isaeva, Irina Gladkikh, Oksana Sintsova, Elena Leychenko, Naoko Kanda
pmc-12607783.description: Psoriasis and allergic contact dermatitis (ACD) are the most common chronic inflammatory diseases, which are accompanied by epithelial alterations and a T cell-mediated immunopathology. In this study, we investigated the anti-ACD and anti-psoriasis effects of sea anemone Heteractis magnifica peptide HCRG21, a blocker of the TRPV1 channel, in 2,4-dinitrofluorobenzene (DNFB)- and imiquimod (IMQ)-induced mouse models, respectively.

pmc-12766837.title: Mechanistic insights into PD-1 inhibitor-associated immune thrombocytopenia: a case report integrating longitudinal transcriptomic profiling
pmc-12766837.creator: Huishan Li, Yan Wang, Jianfeng Zhu, Hehui Chen, Tianshu Liu, Luoyan Ai
pmc-12766837.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have significantly improved survival outcomes in patients with advanced malignancies. However, their association with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) poses a critical risk of severe hemorrhage and necessitates treatment discontinuation. The precise molecular mechanisms underlying ICI-associated ITP remain largely unclear, critically impeding the development of predictive biomarkers and targeted therapeutic strategies.

pmc-12830523.title: Clinical profiles and hospitalization patterns among abused children referred by Child Guidance Centers in Japan
pmc-12830523.creator: Koichi Furuhashi
pmc-12830523.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundChild Guidance Centers (CGCs) play a central role in child protection in Japan, yet evidence on abused children referred to psychiatric services remains limited.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed 84 children referred by CGCs (2019–2023) to a child and adolescent psychiatry department. Demographics, types of abuse, neurodevelopmental disorders (NDs), prior psychiatric care, hospitalization, and experiences of sexual violence by non-caregivers were extracted from medical records and CGC referral forms.

pmc-12838457.title: Exploring the interplay between achievement motivation, students’ satisfaction with their major, and successful intelligence in supporting the sustainability of university education in SAUDI ARABIA
pmc-12838457.creator: Abdulaziz Mohammed Alismail, Mazen Omar Almulla
pmc-12838457.description: In the pursuit of sustainable higher education, understanding the interplay between motivational, affective, and cognitive factors is essential for fostering student success. This study examined the influence among achievement motivation, satisfaction with academic major, and successful intelligence, and their collective role in sustaining higher education outcomes in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-13225553.title: False-positive mammogram has a negative impact on quality of life: A cross-sectional study among Jordanian women at King Abdullah University Hospital
pmc-13225553.creator: Maha M. Gharaibeh, Eyhab A. Elobeid, Sammah M. Ahmmed, Jehad Z. Fataftah, Ruba A. Khasawneh, Mohammad A. Rawashdeh, SayfAldeen M. El-Heis, Safa I. Gharaibeh, Mwaffaq A. Elheis
pmc-13225553.description: Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed cancer among women in Jordan. While mammography is an effective tool for early detection, false-positive results can cause significant psychological and physical distress. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of false-positive mammograms on the quality of life among Jordanian women attending King Abdullah University Hospital.

pmc-13251514.title: Combined torso and foot heat exposure reduces acute ad libitum energy intake in young adults
pmc-13251514.creator: Ge Li, Daiki Watanabe, Yumiko Inoue, Qinlin Jin, Chiho Ezoe, Nan An, Jason Kai Wei Lee, Motohiko Miyachi
pmc-13251514.description: Lowering body temperature with cooling vests has been shown to increase energy intake (EI), but it is unclear whether a heating strategy would have the opposite effect and modify EI. We examined the acute effects of combined torso and foot heat exposure via a hot vest and a warm foot bath on EI.

pmc-13301862.title: Wall thickness channels and lipomatous metaplasia assessed by cardiac computed tomography hypoenhancement as a predictors of deceleration zones in ventricular tachycardia ablation
pmc-13301862.creator: P Rodriguez Fraga, F R Graterol, P Garre, O Ventosa-Blazquez, R Borras, A Victor-Baldoma, M Regany-Closa, E Ayauja Lopez, T Rosseel, J Brugada, L Mont, J T Ortiz, M Sitges, A Porta-Sanchez, I Roca-Luque
pmc-13301862.description: BackgroundCardiac computed tomography (CCT) enables high-resolution myocardial imaging and can identify wall thickness channels (WTCs) and lipomatous metaplasia (LM) within scar regions. However, their relationship with areas of functional slow conduction—specifically, deceleration zones (DZs) identified by isochronal late activation mapping (ILAM)—remains uncertain.

pmc-13413969.title: Magnetorheological Finishing Technology: Research Progress in Materials, Mechanisms, Equipment, and Intelligentization
pmc-13413969.creator: Lingzhi Ding, Guangchao Song, Guili Gao, Dequan Shi
pmc-13413969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Magnetorheological Finishing (MRF) technology, as a deterministic machining method featuring flexibility, controllability, and extremely low subsurface damage, has become one of the most promising technologies in the field of ultra-precision polishing. This review systematically summarizes the research progress of MRF technology in aspects such as polishing fluid preparation and rheological properties, material removal mechanisms and theoretical models, classification and optimization of equipment and processes, multi-energy field hybrid technologies, and intelligent development.

pmc-13534594.title: Sorafenib/piroxicam therapy with biomarker-defined survival benefit in canine muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma
pmc-13534594.creator: Shingo Maeda, Shohei Yokota, Mao Komori, Yuko Goto-Koshino, James K Chambers, Kazuyuki Uchida, Tomohiro Yonezawa, Yasuyuki Momoi
pmc-13534594.description: Molecular-targeted therapies require biomarker-driven evaluation to optimize precision oncology strategies; however, translational models integrating clinical outcomes with mechanistic biomarkers are limited. Canine urothelial carcinoma shares molecular features with human muscle-invasive bladder cancer, including activation of VEGFR signaling, providing a valuable comparative oncology platform.
